mentions.name: Ergonomic Local Sandbox Management Tool
mentions.description: An ergonomic local sandbox management tool, intended for AI agents as well as any other use case. It is currently in dogfooding use and may be open-sourced if it matures.
mentions.problem: The local sandbox management space is crowded, and existing tools don't work the way the author wants.
mentions.source_excerpt: on the side, I'm working on an ergonomic local sandbox management tool. Yes, for AI agents, but also for anything else. Crowded space — there's one at the top of the homepage right now — but at the very least it'll work the way I want it to. Currently dogfooding that; if it gets decent I'd likely open-source it.
